chopped: Wood is in the pack. The roll is still coming.
thawed: The shell is open. The seal is checking.
noShell: No sealed shell in the pack yet.
sealOk: sha256 of the key matches the seal.
title: Sunhoard
intro1: Forty winters since Old Gloam swallowed noon.
intro2: Your lantern is going out. Chop the birch and feed the flame.
intro6: There's a hole in the sky where noon should be.
keeperLine: You are the Keeper, walking up Hollin Vale with the last ember. Thaw what the frost sealed, then the cellar hatch.
txEmpty: Nothing sent yet. Every step, chop and swing lands here.
gate: Connect a devnet wallet to play on chain. Walking needs none.
built: Every step, chop and swing is a gasless transaction on a MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup. Devnet only.
keyUseDoes: Chop, talk, knock at the cellars
roomClear: The room is clear. Leave by the hatch.
fell: You fell. Leave the cellar and mend.
practice: Practice room. Nothing here is on chain.
practiceNote: No session yet, so this is a practice room. Enter the meadow to fight on the rollup.
sealSlot: The seal needs one more slot.
nell1: Is that a fire? Can I come in? I'm good at spotting shiny things.
nell3: Something's been stealing lantern-glass from the cellar under the brambles.
loreBlocks: The light it spilled froze into blocks. They lie sealed in rimeshells, under the frost.
loreHoard: Warmth is money now. Every Glint spent sends a sliver up to the Sunhoard in Old Gloam's belly.
loreKeeper: You are the Keeper. You walk up the valley road with the last ember from the south in your lantern.
questRoad: Walk up the road to the camp fire.
questNell: Someone is warming her hands at the fire. Speak to Nell.
questCellar: Follow the road east to the hatch in the brambles.
questFight: Clear the room. Space swings, Shift dashes.
questDone: The first night is done. Chop, thaw and fight: every Glint spent warms the Sunhoard.
